items.title: Why Is Datadog (DDOG) Winning More Revenue From Existing Customers?
items.summary: Datadog (NasdaqGS: DDOG) reports accelerating adoption of its multi-product platform among existing enterprise customers. More large clients are using a broader mix of Datadog products, deepening commercial relationships and expanding revenue sources. The company highlights cross-selling to current customers as a key driver of higher margin software revenue across its observability and security tools.
